mines.mine_notes: Alaska, 70 miles north of Fairbanks along the Elliott Highway; 100% interest (via Tower Hill Mines, Inc.). As of Dec 31, 2025: proven + probable reserves 430.1 Mt @ 0.65 g/t Au = 9.0 Moz @ $1,680/oz Au (per Technical Report Summary, Exhibit 96.1 to the FY2022 10-K/A filed Oct 17, 2023, based on the Aug 20, 2021 MRE and a Pre-feasibility Study by Whittle Engineering / BBA). Measured + indicated resource exclusive of reserves: 274.51 Mt @ 0.52 g/t = 4.62 Moz @ $1,650/oz. FY2025 activities: metallurgical studies on recoverability of antimony from massive stibnite veins (phase 1 results announced Sept 2025; continuing into 2026). No commercial production. 2026 plan: select technical team to begin feasibility study + permitting, baseline environmental data collection, metallurgy test work. Funded by Jan 27, 2026 financings totaling ~US$114M net (33.672M shares @ US$2.22 public offering + 19.52M-share Paulson & Co. private placement). 10-K does not restate PFS economics; not fabricated here.

notes: FY ended Dec 31, 2025; figures USD. Development-stage company — no production, no revenue. FY2025 net loss $4.64M (2024: $3.60M); cash $1.35M at Dec 31, 2025 ($0.99M at Dec 31, 2024). Head office: 200 Burrard Street, Suite 1570, Vancouver BC V6C 3L6. Post-FY Jan 2026 raised ~US$114M net to fund feasibility study and permitting.
